description: The landmark layers of the U.S. Census Bureau's TIGER/Line Shapefiles locate special features that the Census Bureau keeps in its MAF/TIGER database to help enumerators in the field. Area Landmark files (by state) contain polygons such as airports, cemeteries, parks and educational facilities; Point Landmark files (by state) contain points such as schools and churches; a national Military Installation file contains the area of military bases. Every landmark has a MAF/TIGER Feature Class Code (MTFCC) that gives its type (the full list is in Appendix E of the documentation), a unique identifier and, where known, a name. Coverage: the 50 states, the District of Columbia, Puerto Rico and the Island Areas; annual vintages, the 2025 files released on 23 September 2025. Format and access: shapefiles on the FTP site and web interface, and in the TIGER geodatabases and GeoPackages; free and public domain. Caveats: the Census Bureau adds landmarks as needed and does not try to include every instance of a feature type, so the layers are not complete facility inventories; point landmarks inside area landmarks are not linked. Simulation uses: a free national set of airport, port, park, school, hospital, prison and military-base footprints for critical-facility screening, exposure checks and as a cross-check for dedicated facility inventories. Related records: HIFLD Open (dedicated critical infrastructure layers), NCES EDGE school locations, TIGER hydrography and boundaries, and TIGERweb.
